proposed_compilation_title: Development Process Manual Executive Committee Minutes, 2015

proposed_table_of_contents.content: The committee held seven regular meetings in 2015. The February 18 meeting was not held (a February 5 or 6 working session with the UDO consultant left no minutes); no meeting was held from July through September; the November 18 meeting was cancelled for lack of action items. The April 15 minutes were also posted under a second filename, and agendas survive for April 15 and May 20, but approved minutes exist for both, so neither agenda is included.

recommended_publication_form.rationale: One 20-page compilation: all seven approved 2015 minutes in date order (13 pages) followed by the February 2015 Preface and Update Procedure as an appendix (7 pages), far below the 100-150 page split threshold. The minutes are one- and two-page procedural records that document the DPM's planned division between the UDO and a technical manual only when read together.
recommended_publication_form.standalone_entries: None recommended once the compilation exists.
recommended_publication_form.prerequisite: Six of the seven minutes and the Preface are inventory status excluded or pending review with no archive copy; Codex must archive and verify them before the compilation is built.

provenance_notes: All ten 2015 files and the Preface fetched from documents.cabq.gov on 2026-09-13; each returned HTTP 200 with PDF leading bytes.
